subject: Next steps: Exec panel logistics, procurement gates, and security checklist
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@shelfspace.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap + proposal for exec panel and procurement path

Emma — great to meet today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same runway:

Call highlights
- Business need: ShelfSpace wants 95th percentile inference latency under 120ms for product search re-ranks at peak traffic, and an embeddings pipeline for nightly catalog updates.
- Decision criteria: latency SLAs, predictable per-token cost, SOC2/compliance evidence, and procurement/contract timeline.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Emma (economic buyer), Rajiv (security), procurement (legal/contracts).

Proposed next steps
1) Exec panel (45 min): Quick technical readout + cost projection + procurement checklist. Suggested windows: Jun 23–25 mornings PDT.
2) Security packet: I’m attaching a SOC2 summary and a short SLA matrix. Can Rajiv confirm any additional artifacts required (pen tests, encryption attestation, or data residency proof)?
3) Procurement path: Ben will follow up with standard SOW/contract timeline assumptions and redlines cadence.

Who will attend from ShelfSpace? Please confirm the exec who will present priorities on your side (we’ll prepare an economics slide). Also confirm a procurement contact for a draft contract.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Redwood_SLA_v2.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll hold the proposed slots tentatively.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0129
From: Emma Li <emma.li@shelfspace.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@shelfspace.com>, procurement@shelfspace.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal for exec panel and procurement path

Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers and asks:

1) Attendance: I’ll be the economic sponsor and can join the exec panel. I’d like our CTO (Anika Patel) to join for the technical/latency discussion — she’s available Jun 24 morning PDT.
2) Security: Rajiv here — the SOC2 summary is helpful. We will need a copy of the pen test report (past 12 months) and details on key management (KMS/HSM). Can you also confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys in the private deployment?
3) Procurement: procurement@shelfspace.com (CC’d) will need a Statement of Work draft and an estimated lead time for completion.

Also, on decision criteria: beyond latency and cost we’ll be evaluating failure modes (graceful degradation/fallbacks) and operational dashboards (traceability for token-level costs). Can you highlight those in the exec panel?

Emma
VP Product, ShelfSpace Inc.
emma.li@shelfspace.com | +1 (617) 555-1456
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@shelfspace.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@shelfspace.com>, procurement@shelfspace.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal for exec panel and procurement path

Emma / team — quick follow-up from procurement and security standpoint:

Procurement/process
- I’ll drop a draft SOW and a standard enterprise MSA by EOD Fri (link will go to the Drive folder). Expect a 2–3 week redline cadence for your legal + ours for typical mid-market deals; we can compress if needed for an earlier go-live.
- Pricing pathways: 1) Hosted: usage-based (tokens + embeddings) with burst autoscale; 2) Dedicated: reserved GPU pools (committed monthly). I’ll include sample TCO scenarios for 12/24 months in the SOW.

Security artifacts & technical notes
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (summary), and a separate spreadsheet with your security questions (ShelfSpace_Security_Questions.xlsx) — please add any missing asks.
- Regarding pen tests: we can provide a redacted pen test summary; full report requires an NDA (link to DocuSign below).
- Customer-managed keys: supported in Redwood Private via KMS integrations; I’ll link a short note in the drive for Rajiv.

Exec panel content
- We’ll run a 20-minute technical demo (latency and fallback behavior), 10-minute economics, 10-minute Q&A. Vivek will lead the demo; Laura (my manager) will join for pricing/discussion.

Related links (drafts will be uploaded):
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RWI-2027-SS-3049
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-ShelfSpace-Onboarding
- DocuSign NDA: https://www.docusign.com/ss/RWI-ShelfSpace-NDA

Attaching: ShelfSpace_Security_Questions.xlsx

—
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:37:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Exec panel RSVP and runbook

Folks — quick internal checklist before I confirm the Jun 24 slot with ShelfSpace: 

1) Attendees (Redwood): Vivek (demo owner), Ben (commercial questions + SOW), Laura (pricing + escalation). Add engineering: request that Andrew Mills (TP infra lead) join for the latency Q&A — he can do Jun 24 09:30–10:15 PDT.
2) Deliverables by Tue EOD (Jun 22):
   - Vivek: 2-slide economics snapshot (cost at scale, burst scenarios)
   - Ben: draft SOW + TCO workbook uploaded to Drive
   - Andrew: latency micro-benchmark slides + fallback behavior diagram
   - Security: Ben to request redacted pen test and coordinate NDA if needed
3) Procurement gating: ask procurement to prepare a list of standard SLAs and termination clauses they require; Laura to provide annotated clause language for our redlines.

I’ll confirm the Jun 24 09:00–09:45 PDT slot with Emma and request an attendee list (Anika + Rajiv + procurement rep). If we need the slot changed I’ll coordinate immediately.

Thanks — let’s keep this tight.

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0250
